title: Royal and privileged Hungarian
html_source: Bloom had been suspected, but never charged a decade earlier, of running a fraudulent foreign lottery by that name. Perhaps the suspicion, as it was with this slur, was merely a reflection of prevailing antisemitism. It would run counter to Bloom’s character to attempt such a crime.
